changes_vs_current: McDonald's #3 to #1 and Wendy's/Chick-fil-A/Taco Bell fill the top 4; In-N-Out, Whataburger, Shake Shack, Culver's, Jack in the Box, Del Taco, Carl's Jr. fall out (next in line: Whataburger 21.8, Culver's 22.0, Jimmy John's 23.0, In-N-Out 23.7); added Domino's, Dunkin', Pizza Hut, Panera, Starbucks, Little Caesars, Papa John's.
confidence: medium. Three independent US measures (popularity poll, consideration poll, sales) agree on the top 4. Weaknesses: only 3 sources; consideration list is top 10 only; national samples structurally penalize regional chains (In-N-Out, Whataburger, Culver's sit just below the cut, 21.8 to 23.7 vs the 24th spot at 21.5); Baskin-Robbins, Cinnabon, Krispy Kreme etc. were excluded as dessert-only; Starbucks and Dunkin' kept as QSR 50 counts them.
